author: GitHub
description:
In this clip from our OpenClaw fireside chat, Dave Morin explains why software development is shifting away from 2010s grind culture and back toward open exploration. He compares today's wave of open AI tools to the early internet era, where sheer curiosity drove developers to build and share ideas together. Watch the full conversation on the GitHub channel to see how open frameworks are making software creation fun again.
